source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Svenja Stern; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 59685

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 59685; AKU grapheme G0540 (AKU GR 274). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: G41 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 220 (v4p12), 221, 222. Occurrence: line 5; find place Theben West; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 4.2 x 5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie, Thutmosis III.". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Svenja Stern. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
